description: This file implements the cTimer class, which provides a timer mechanism with threading support. It includes constructor, destructor, methods to start, stop, attach/detach threads, set interval, and check activity status, along with a timer thread function that calls a user-defined callback periodically.

classes.name: cTimer
classes.description: A timer class that runs a callback function periodically on a separate thread.

methods.name: ~cTimer
methods.description: Destructor that marks the timer as cleared.

methods.name: timerFunction
methods.description: Thread function executing the callback at specified intervals until cleared.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer thread; returns false if interval is non-positive or callback is null.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the timer thread to stop by setting the clear flag.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the timer thread from the current thread.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the timer thread if joinable.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the callback function and interval duration for the timer.
